bets.name: Tata Consultancy Services
bets.thesis: As a leader in the IT services space, TCS is benefiting from renewed investor interest and strong sectoral momentum. Its large-cap status makes it a preferred choice for institutional flows.

bets.name: Infosys Ltd
bets.thesis: Infosys, another IT behemoth, mirrored the strength of its peers. Continued demand for digital transformation services is likely to sustain its upward trajectory.

bets.name: ICICI Bank
bets.thesis: Despite being a fundamentally strong private sector bank, ICICI Bank was among the top losers, reflecting a broader weakness or profit booking in the financial sector. Short-term downside risk.

bets.name: Tech Mahindra
bets.thesis: This IT services firm recorded significant gains, contributing to the overall IT sector's rally. Its performance suggests potential for further growth in line with the sector.

bets.name: Shree Cement
bets.thesis: Shree Cement was one of the top losers, indicating stock-specific weakness despite the NIFTY REALTY showing slight positive movement. May face continued selling pressure in the short term.
